scoring_justification: Recomputing pair binding energies and band gap from raw DFT outputs is infeasible in a verifier; instead compare reported quantities to paper-reported references with tolerances and structural ordering.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference pair binding energies and band gap for scoring
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 1 (PbTe ~1.0 eV), Fig. 2 (SnTe/GeTe ~0.5 eV), text (band gap 78.2 meV).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values taken from paper discussion; the reference solve.sh uses these exact values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper-reported approximate values, used as thresholds for trend and absolute tolerances.

outputs.description: Pair binding energies for (Ag,Sb) in each host. Hidden checker compares reported values to reference values within tolerances and checks that Eb_2nd_nn > Eb_5th_nn for each host.
Direct band gap at Gamma for PbTe (Ag,Sb) 2nd n.n. configuration. Compared to expected value within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All energies in electronvolts (eV). Agent must run DFT calculations using the public resources listed. The hidden checker performs result‑level comparison with tolerances and a structural ordering check.

steps.description: Ensure file exists and is parseable JSON with required keys
Check that reported Eb_2nd_nn values are within ±0.2 eV of paper references for each host
Verify that for each host, Eb_2nd_nn > Eb_5th_nn (preference for 2nd n.n.)
Ensure file exists and contains key
Check direct band gap at Gamma for PbTe (Ag,Sb) 2nd n.n. within ±20 meV of paper value (78.2 meV)
